overview: About 280 teeth, jaws and ankle bones from the early Eocene revise the older picture of “Miacis” latouri based on only two teeth.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports an inference of small-prey or insect eating; stomach contents are not preserved.
ecology.habitat: A warm woodland is inferred from the locality context, not directly recorded as the animal’s preferred habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Tarsal anatomy suggests climbing ability, but movement was not observed.
ecology.bodySize: The sample documents a small carnivoraform; it does not provide a precise body-mass estimate.
ecology.guild: A small, climbing-capable faunivore is an anatomical inference, not a directly observed ecological role.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持其取食小型猎物或昆虫的推断；没有保存胃内容物。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据地点背景推测当地曾有温暖林地，但不能据此断定这是该动物偏好的栖地。
ecology.locomotionZh: 跗骨形态提示其可能具有攀爬能力，但没有直接观察到运动方式。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 材料显示这是一种小型食肉形类，但没有给出精确体重估计。
ecology.guildZh: 把它描述为小型、可能善于攀爬的食虫或食肉动物，是基于解剖的推断，并非直接观察到的生态角色。

traits: The expanded sample supports a reconstructed permanent dentition.
Ankle bones include astragali and a calcaneum.
A sampled character matrix places it among basal carnivoraforms.
evidenceSummary: The fossils support dental, ankle and matrix observations. They do not demonstrate membership in crown Carnivora, a direct ancestor, or the global first carnivoramorphan.
overviewZh: 早始新世材料包括约 280 枚牙齿、颌骨和踝骨，补充了过去仅凭两枚牙齿认识的“Miacis” latouri。
traitsZh: 扩大的标本组合支持重建其恒齿列。
踝部材料包括距骨和跟骨。
一项取样的特征矩阵将其置于基础食肉形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 化石支持牙齿、踝部和矩阵分析中的观察。它们不能证明该动物属于冠群食肉目、是某类群的直接祖先，或是全球最早的食肉形动物。

commonNameZh: 西藏化石豹亚科（原始归属）
overview: Three cranial fragments from the Zanda Basin were assigned to Panthera blytheae in the original combined fossil–molecular analysis. That study also placed it near snow leopards, but both the genus assignment and that relationship remain revisable results of the analysis.

ecology.diet: Felid dentition supports a meat-eating diet, but the partial skull does not reveal prey choice.
ecology.habitat: The Zanda Basin's high-elevation environment is inferred from regional evidence, not directly measured from this skull.
ecology.locomotion: The cranial sample does not preserve how the animal moved.
ecology.bodySize: Body size was inferred from partial cranial material, not measured from a complete skeleton.
ecology.guild: The study inferred a large terrestrial carnivore from the teeth; prey and behaviour are not preserved.
ecology.dietZh: 猫科动物的齿列支持肉食性判断，但不完整的头骨无法揭示其猎物选择。
ecology.habitatZh: 根据区域证据推断 Zanda 盆地属于高海拔环境；这一点并非直接从该头骨测得。
ecology.locomotionZh: 颅骨样本没有保存其运动方式的信息。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 体型是根据部分头骨材料推断，而非依据完整骨架测量。
ecology.guildZh: 研究根据牙齿推断其为大型陆生食肉动物；化石没有保存猎物或行为信息。

traits: Adult partial cranium
Associated ramus and premaxilla fragments
Characters used in a combined total-evidence analysis
evidenceSummary: The IVPP V18788.1–3 material and its original magnetostratigraphic age model are documented. The taxonomic assignment and proposed snow-leopard affinity remain revisable, and this Zanda sample does not establish an Asian origin for all pantherines.

title.zh: 三件头骨材料构成这份记录

text.en: The original study describes IVPP V18788.1 as an adult partial cranium, with IVPP V18788.2–3 adding associated jaw and premaxilla fragments. The material comes from China's Zanda Basin in the Tibetan Himalaya. Its age envelope of 5.95–4.10 million years follows the study's original magnetostratigraphic framework; it is not a species-wide first or last appearance.
text.zh: 原研究将 IVPP V18788.1 描述为成年个体的局部颅骨，IVPP V18788.2–3 补充了相关颌骨和前颌骨碎片。材料来自中国西藏喜马拉雅地区的札达盆地。5.95–4.10 百万年前的年代包络遵循原研究磁性地层年代模型，并非该物种的首现或末现。

title.en: A proposed relationship, not a settled ancestor
title.zh: 提出的亲缘关系，不是已定论的祖先

text.en: The combined analysis assigned these fragments to Panthera and recovered an affinity with snow leopards. Those are analytical placements rather than facts visible in the fossil itself. Felid teeth support carnivory, but this cranial sample does not identify prey, locomotion or habitual habitat, and one Tibetan locality cannot establish the geographic origin of all pantherines.
text.zh: 综合分析把这些碎片归入 Panthera，并恢复出与雪豹的亲缘关系；这两项都是分析位置，不能直接从化石本身看出。猫科牙齿支持肉食性，但这组颅骨材料不能确定猎物、运动方式或惯常栖息环境；札达的一个地点也不能确定整个豹亚科的地理起源。

title.en: Tseng et al. (2014), Zanda Basin pantherine fossils
title.zh: Tseng 等（2014），札达盆地豹亚科化石

scope.en: IVPP V18788.1–3, the Zanda Basin locality, original magnetostratigraphic framework, Figures 1–4, Table S1 and Data S1–S3. The study supports its combined-analysis placement; it does not make the snow-leopard affinity or a pantherine origin in Asia uncontested.
scope.zh: IVPP V18788.1–3、札达盆地地点、原始磁性地层年代框架、图 1–4、表 S1 与数据 S1–S3。该研究支持综合分析中的位置，但不能使雪豹亲缘关系或豹亚科起源于亚洲成为无争议结论。

overview: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves about 65% of one skeleton. Its weight-bearing limbs occur with traits used to infer freshwater swimming, a combination relevant to hypotheses about pinnipedimorph transitions.

ecology.diet: Dentition supports a carnivorous diet; prey are not directly preserved.
ecology.habitat: The fossil occurs in a freshwater-lake deposit. A habitual freshwater habitat is inferred rather than observed.
ecology.locomotion: Limb and body proportions support both terrestrial and semiaquatic capability as interpretations, not measured performance.
ecology.bodySize: The animal is described as medium musteloid-sized; the available account does not give a complete population range.
ecology.guild: A semiaquatic predatory role is inferred from anatomy and setting.
ecology.dietZh: 牙齿支持肉食性推断；没有直接保存猎物。
ecology.habitatZh: 化石出自淡水湖沉积层。长期利用淡水栖地是推断，并非直接观察。
ecology.locomotionZh: 肢体和身体比例支持其既能陆行、又可能半水生的解释，但运动表现没有经过测量。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 资料将其描述为中等鼬科动物大小；现有叙述没有给出完整的种群体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 依据解剖和沉积背景推测其为半水生捕食者。

traits: The holotype includes substantial cranial and postcranial material.
Its limbs could bear weight and also show proportions used to infer swimming.
A long tail and freshwater depositional context contribute to the semiaquatic interpretation.
evidenceSummary: The associated skeleton supports an anatomical mosaic. Semiaquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph placement and a freshwater transition are interpretations, not an ancestor sequence.
overviewZh: 正模 NUFV 405 保存了约 65% 的一具骨架。可承重的四肢与用于推断淡水游泳能力的特征并存，这种组合与鳍足类演化过渡的假说有关。
traitsZh: 正模保存了较多颅后和头骨材料。
四肢可支撑身体，也具有被用于推断游泳能力的比例特征。
长尾及淡水湖沉积背景共同参与半水生生活方式的解释。
evidenceSummaryZh: 关节连接的骨架显示了特征组合。半水生运动、鳍足类位置和淡水环境转变都是解释，并非一条已证实的祖先序列。

geography: North American Hesperocyoninae localities sampled by Wang
overview: Wang's monograph studies named Hesperocyon fossils within the extinct hesperocyonine canid radiation. A morphology matrix scores cranial and dental characters to test relationships among sampled species; the analysis does not identify Hesperocyon as a direct ancestor of later canids.

ecology.diet: The systematic monograph does not directly establish diet.
ecology.habitat: The monograph's fossil localities do not establish a genus-wide habitat.
ecology.locomotion: The cited monograph does not establish postcranial locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: The sampled material is not used here to estimate a genus-wide body-size range.
ecology.guild: The cited systematic evidence does not assign a single ecological guild.
ecology.dietZh: 系统分类专著没有直接确定其食性。
ecology.habitatZh: 专著列出的化石地点不能确定该属整体的生境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所引专著没有确定其头后骨骼所反映的运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 此处未利用取样材料估算该属整体的体型范围。
ecology.guildZh: 所引系统学证据未指定单一生态类群。

traits: Named Hesperocyon specimens revised in a fossil canid monograph
Dental and cranial characters scored in a morphology matrix
Species-level relationships tested within sampled Hesperocyoninae
evidenceSummary: The 40–29 Ma display refers only to the Hesperocyon material sampled in Wang's monograph and its North American localities. It is not a complete genus range, a global origination or extinction estimate, or a continuous-occupancy claim. Ecology and direct ancestry are not established by this systematic sample.

title.en: A monograph and a morphology matrix
title.zh: 专著与形态矩阵如何重建关系

text.en: Wang's revision assembles named fossil material and scores cranial and dental characters in a morphology matrix to test species-level relationships within Hesperocyoninae, an extinct canid subfamily. Its results describe the sampled fossil record and character analysis; they do not make Hesperocyon a demonstrated direct ancestor of later dogs.
text.zh: Wang 的修订汇集具名化石材料，并将颅骨与牙齿性状编码到形态矩阵中，检验灭绝犬科黄昏犬亚科内部的物种关系。结果描述的是该化石样本和性状分析，并没有证明 Hesperocyon 是后期犬类的直系祖先。

title.en: The study window has a limited scope
title.zh: 研究样本的年代与范围有限

text.en: The monograph's Hesperocyon sample comes from North American Hesperocyoninae localities. The 40–29 Ma display is a source-bounded window for that sample, not a global species duration, exact origin or extinction date, or claim of continuous presence. The cited systematic work does not directly establish diet, habitat preference, movement, body-size range, or one ecological guild.
text.zh: 专著取样的是北美黄昏犬亚科产地。40–29 Ma 的显示窗口只对应该研究所采样的 Hesperocyon 材料，不是全球物种延限、精确起源或灭绝时间，也不表示该属连续存在。所引系统研究没有直接确定其食性、栖息偏好、运动方式、属级体型范围或单一生态功能群。

title.en: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae)
title.zh: Phylogenetic systematics of the Hesperocyoninae (Carnivora: Canidae)

geography: Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member, Jewett Sand
overview: The nearly complete Enaliarctos mealsi skeleton LACM 4321 anchors a study of early pinniped locomotor anatomy. Its vertebrae and limbs support comparisons of aquatic and terrestrial capability, not a direct-ancestor claim or a complete genus history.

ecology.diet: Not resolved by the cited skeletal locomotor study
ecology.habitat: Jewett Sand depositional setting; habitual ecology is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Aquatic and terrestrial locomotor capacities inferred comparatively from axial and limb anatomy
ecology.bodySize: Not projected as a genus-wide body-size estimate from one skeleton
ecology.guild: No feeding guild is assigned from the cited skeletal evidence

traits: Virtually complete LACM 4321 skeleton
Flexible lumbar vertebral morphology in the comparative interpretation
Flipper-like limbs with developed bony processes and muscle-attachment areas
evidenceSummary: LACM 4321 comes from the Pyramid Hill Sandstone Member of California’s Jewett Sand and is dated approximately to 23 Ma. Swimming strokes, habitual habitat, diet and a universal pinniped history are not directly observed in this specimen.

title.en: One skeleton preserves spine and limbs together
title.zh: 一具骨架同时保存脊柱与四肢

text.en: LACM 4321 is a virtually complete skeleton of Enaliarctos mealsi. The study draws on its lumbar vertebrae, flipper-like limbs and developed bony processes with muscle-attachment areas to compare locomotor anatomy. Those are observations on one fossil; they are not measurements of every Enaliarctos species or a population-wide body-size range.
text.zh: LACM 4321 是一具近乎完整的 Enaliarctos mealsi 骨架。研究利用其腰椎、鳍状四肢，以及发达的骨突和肌肉附着区来比较运动解剖。这些是对一件化石的观察，并非对所有 Enaliarctos 物种的测量，也不能给出整个类群的体型范围。

title.en: Anatomy suggests capability, not observed behavior
title.zh: 解剖提示能力，不等于观察到行为

text.en: Comparisons of the spine and limbs are used to infer how this animal may have moved in water and on land. A skeletal model can test which movements were anatomically possible, but it does not preserve a swimming stroke, daily habitat or feeding event. The roughly 23 Ma occurrence is one central-California record and does not trace a route of pinniped dispersal.
text.zh: 研究通过比较脊柱与四肢，推断这只动物可能如何在水中和陆地上移动。骨骼模型可以检验哪些动作在解剖上可能，却不会保存游泳动作、日常栖息地或摄食事件。约 23 Ma 的记录来自加利福尼亚中部一处地点，不能单独重建鳍足类的扩散路线。

overview: Lycophocyon hutchisoni is represented by holotype cranium UCMP 85202 and associated southern Californian skull, jaw and postcranial material from about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places it among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.

ecology.diet: A six-variable discriminant model predicts carnivory for the holotype with 83% posterior probability; this is a model result, not observed feeding.
ecology.habitat: The specimens come from member C of the Santiago Formation; this depositional context does not establish habitual habitat.
ecology.locomotion: Postcranial elements are known, but the cited studies do not establish locomotor performance.
ecology.bodySize: A tooth-based regression estimates about 6 kg for the holotype; the estimate is not generalized across the genus.
ecology.guild: No broader ecological guild is assigned from a dietary classifier.
ecology.dietZh: 一个包含六个变量的判别模型以 83% 的后验概率预测正模为食肉性；这是模型结果，并非观察到的摄食行为。
ecology.habitatZh: 标本来自圣地亚哥组 C 段；这一沉积背景不能确定其惯常栖息环境。
ecology.locomotionZh: 已知有后颅骨材料，但所引研究未能确定其运动能力。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 基于牙齿的回归估计正模体重约为 6 kg；这一估计未推广到整个属。
ecology.guildZh: 根据摄食分类器结果，没有为其指定更广泛的生态功能类群。

traits: The holotype UCMP 85202 preserves the cranium and dentition.
Associated SDSNH specimens add cranial, mandibular and selected postcranial bones.
The phylogenetic sample combines named cranial and postcranial material.
evidenceSummary: The specimen set and southern Californian horizon bound this account. Caniform placement and the 83% dietary classification depend on a morphological matrix and comparative model; neither establishes direct ancestry, a complete range or observed behaviour.
overviewZh: Lycophocyon hutchisoni 由正模头骨 UCMP 85202 及相关的南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料代表，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛的形态分析未能解决其与近缘食肉形类的关系；仅包含古近纪类群的子集则将它置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。
evidenceSummaryZh: 本页由这组标本及南加州层位限定范围。犬形类位置和 83% 的食性分类结果取决于形态矩阵与比较模型；两者都不能证明直接祖先关系、完整分布或实际观察到的行为。

readerSources.title: A new basal caniform (Mammalia: Carnivora) from the middle Eocene of North America and remarks on the phylogeny of early carnivorans

scope.en: Tomiya (2011), pp. 2–3 and 13–16, Figures 2–8, Table 3 and Appendix S3: type and referred material, local horizon, matrix-based placements, and the 83% dietary classifier for the holotype.
scope.zh: Tomiya（2011），第 2–3、13–16 页，图 2–8、表 3 与附录 S3：正模及归入标本、局部层位、矩阵分析位置，以及正模的 83% 食性分类器结果。

title.zh: UCMP 85202 与仅含古近纪类群的系统位置

text.en: Lycophocyon hutchisoni is represented by holotype cranium UCMP 85202 and associated southern Californian skull, jaw and postcranial material from about 46.2–42 Ma. A broad morphology analysis leaves nearby carnivoramorphan relationships unresolved; a Paleogene-only subset places it among caniforms outside crown Canoidea.
text.zh: Lycophocyon hutchisoni 由正模头骨 UCMP 85202 及相关的南加州头骨、颌骨和颅后材料代表，年代约为 46.2–42 Ma。广泛的形态分析未能解决其与近缘食肉形类的关系；仅包含古近纪类群的子集则将它置于冠群犬总科之外的犬形类中。

title.en: A specimen-bounded diet model and range
title.zh: 由标本限定的食性模型与分布范围

text.en: The specimen set and southern Californian horizon bound this account. Caniform placement and the 83% dietary classification depend on a morphological matrix and comparative model; neither establishes direct ancestry, a complete range or observed behaviour.
text.zh: 本页由这组标本及南加州层位限定范围。犬形类位置和 83% 的食性分类结果取决于形态矩阵与比较模型；两者都不能证明直接祖先关系、完整分布或实际观察到的行为。

traitsZh: 正模 UCMP 85202 保存了头骨和齿列。
关联的 SDSNH 标本补充了颅骨、下颌和部分头后骨骼。
系统发育样本结合了具名的头骨和后颅骨材料。

overview: Kretzoiarctos beatrix is described from a left fourth premolar, a right first molar and a partial mandible from two Spanish middle Miocene localities. A fossil-and-living bear matrix places the genus within Ailuropodinae.

ecology.diet: Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency; feeding was not observed
ecology.habitat: Spanish locality records only; habitual habitat is not directly observed
ecology.locomotion: Not resolved by the cited dental and mandibular material
ecology.bodySize: Small-sized ailuropodine in the published diagnosis; no population estimate is projected
ecology.guild: No ecological guild is assigned from the available dental sample

traits: Holotype left P4 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42
Paratype right M1 NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473
Published dental and mandibular morphology documented from the named specimens
evidenceSummary: The named dental specimens and localities are direct records. Subfamily placement and a more herbivorous tendency come from comparative analyses; they do not establish direct ancestry, an origin centre or a global first appearance.

title.en: A bear known from a small dental sample
title.zh: 来自有限牙齿样本的熊类

text.en: The account centers on holotype left P4 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, paratype right M1 NV-2-40 and partial mandible IPS 46473 from two Spanish localities. These teeth and jaw form the anatomical sample.
text.zh: 研究材料包括正模左侧第四前臼齿 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42、副模右侧第一臼齿 NV-2-40，以及部分下颌 IPS 46473，来自西班牙两个地点。这些牙齿和下颌构成形态样本。

title.en: A comparative placement, not an ancestor
title.zh: 比较分析给出的分类位置不等于祖先

text.en: A matrix combining living and fossil bears places Kretzoiarctos within Ailuropodinae. Dental comparisons suggest a more herbivorous tendency, but feeding was not observed. The sample does not identify a direct ancestor of the giant panda or prove identical ecology.
text.zh: 结合现生与化石熊类的矩阵将 Kretzoiarctos 置于熊猫亚科。牙齿比较提示其食性可能更偏植食，但研究没有观察进食行为。现有样本不能确认它是大熊猫的直系祖先或证明生态完全相同。

evidenceSummaryZh: 列出的牙齿标本和地点是直接记录。亚科归属和偏向植食的趋势来自比较分析；这些分析不能确定直接祖先关系、起源中心或全球最早出现时间。
